_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/weekly-budget.json and edit. Delete the _comment keys.
_reset_dow: Day of the week your plan's weekly limit resets, in LOCAL time. Find it in /usage. Omit or null = fall back to a rolling 7-day window.
_reset_hour: Hour of that day, 0-23, LOCAL time. 20 = 8pm.
_scale: Percent-of-plan per USD of API-equivalent spend. DO NOT hand-edit. Written for you by: powershell -File ~/.claude/tools/weekly-usage.ps1 -CalibratePct <the % /usage currently shows>. While this is null the statusline shows an amber dollar figure instead of a percentage.
_cal_note: Stamped automatically when you calibrate, so you can see how old the calibration is.
